items: Nanjing is a portability demonstration, not a primary proving ground with Medellín-equivalent local validation.
Outputs are adaptation-screening results, not hydraulic flood predictions or inundation depths.
Terrain-derived drainage-stress indicators are screening proxies, not flood probability.
WorldPop 2026 values are population estimates, not census counts or exact households.
ESA WorldCover classes are not measured imperviousness or calibrated runoff coefficients.
Intervention-effect ranges remain explicit planning assumptions unless separately evidenced.
Official Nanjing municipal projects are retrospective qualitative evidence only and were never used as optimizer inputs.
Do not claim Ourea discovered the 9,000 m³ Hengyang Lake / Jiuxiang detention facility.
Do not claim municipal endorsement, China-wide validation, people saved, or avoided losses.
No fabricated Chinese socioeconomic or equity layer is present; equity lenses are intentionally disabled.
